notes.title: Mount Your Friends Update Tu.Tu brings more Multiplayer Modifiers
notes.notes: Thanks everyone who has been enjoying Mount Your Friends! All the custom outfits, online matches, and general sillyness has been great. Today comes the release of version Tu.Tu, which brings with it more variety for your online matches! Two new Levels/Modes have been introduced that will have new strategies in competitive play, as well as new spawn options so that the Storm environment doesn't have to be the most unfair setting ever. Lobbies also now have a soundboard-style chat system so you can be more coordinated with your fellow mounters! I hope everyone tries these new additions and takes advantage of having yet another excuse to get mounting!
